title: calycera lanata
intro: Calycera lanata, commonly known as Woolly Calycera, is a plant species belonging to the Calyceraceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of various infections and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Calycera lanata include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
